values.summary: Bootstrap #491, obtain design approval, bind a FastWork worktree after #490 terminal ancestry, implement the GCP Terraform backend/deployment-identity bootstrap, run focused static and safe GCP readback validation, obtain exact-head review, publish, and finish when green.

steps.action: Bootstrap and approve the GCP-B Terraform bootstrap design.
Bind the #491 FastWork execution worktree after #490 terminal ancestry is verified.
Implement Terraform backend, deployment identity, runbook, saved-plan, cleanup, and proof surfaces.
Validate, obtain fresh exact-head review, publish with closing linkage, and finish when green.

invariants: Steady-state execution prefers impersonation over static keys
The local static key stays outside the repository under /Users/daniel/keys
Retained evidence never includes credentials, token material, or service-account private-key JSON
Provider pins and saved-plan review are explicit before apply
Local bootstrap state is removed or quarantined recoverably after backend migration
risks: Static key material can leak if commands print or copy the JSON
Terraform can target the wrong project if provider identity is implicit
Remote state can be public, unversioned, or unrecoverable if bucket controls are incomplete
Local bootstrap state can retain resource identifiers or secrets after migration
Unpinned providers or modules can drift between review and apply
stop_conditions: Credential material would enter retained evidence
Local bootstrap state cannot be removed recoverably
GCP mutation would target a non-company or non-host project
